# Sahkarmi

> Sahkarmi (सहकर्मी, "coworker") is a free, open-source desktop app, built in India, that gives a small business a team of AI coworkers. Each coworker has its own workspace, browser, memory and task queue, and asks the owner before payments, customer messages, publishing or form submissions. Tagline: "Your AI team. Made in India."

Key facts:

- Product category: AI coworker / AI productivity desktop app. Local-first: coworkers, chats, files and settings are stored on the user's computer; there is no Sahkarmi cloud account.
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) is the main build; macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (AppImage) builds are published on GitHub Releases.
- Price: free. Free AI models are built in through bundled OpenCode (no login). Optional: reuse existing sign-ins of Codex CLI (ChatGPT), Claude Code and Gemini CLI on the same computer; paid plans are billed by those providers.
- Default team (editable): Asha (Accounts), Vikram (Sales), Meera (Support), Arjun (Research), Kavya (Content).
- Features: built-in browser per coworker with a "Take over" button for logins and OTPs, Approvals inbox, task queue, scheduled tasks, shared files folder, English / Hindi / Bengali interface.
- Status: development preview. In the current release, approvals before risky actions rely on coworkers following their instructions.
- Licence: Apache License 2.0. Based on OpenBot v0.1.11 by Norbert Bodziony.
